source: Alicia_D_v5_6_gripper_50mm.urdf (teleop repository, alicia_d_descriptions/urdf), joint origins, axes and the gripper_center fixed joint copied verbatim

tool.note: The fingertip plane on the gripper centre line; +Z is the approach axis, the fingers open along +/-Y to 25.5 mm each side.

calibration_note: A reported joint angle plus its lane's offset is the URDF angle. The simulation offsets are the visual offsets the scene's policy mode adds before driving (teleop run_alicia_stack.sh, set by the operator on 2026-10-17); the physical offsets are unmeasured and must be verified by the operator before this file is used for a physical plan.
validated: 2026-10-18: forward kinematics of a still simulation sample with the simulation offsets reproduced the scene's published gripper_center position to 0.0 mm; a moving sample differed by 6 mm from sampling skew.
